message.content:
**Battle of Stalingrad (1942‑1943)** | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Main Participants** | • **Soviet Union** – Red Army (commanded by General Georgy Zhukov, with key units such as the 62nd Army and the 64th Army).
• **Nazi Germany** – German Army Group South (led by Field Marshal Friedrich Paulus, with the 6th Army as the principal force). | | **Location** | The city of **Stalingrad** (now **Volgograd**) in southern Russia, situated on the western bank of the **Volga River**. The battle encompassed the urban center, surrounding suburbs, and the Volga’s strategic crossing points. | The confrontation became one of the deadliest and most pivotal battles of World War II, ultimately marking the turning point on the Eastern Front in favor of the Allies.
